import os
p='/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689749/attempts/31c36fde4a524b3f9529214b2feb9fae/system/state/workspace/programs'
os.makedirs(p,exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    # The colored object is the motif; copy its occupied-cell mask onto
    # every translated location where all motif cells are background zeros.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    color = next(v for row in grid for v in row if v not in (0, 8))
    points = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == color]
    r0 = min(r for r, c in points)
    c0 = min(c for r, c in points)
    shape = [(r-r0, c-c0) for r, c in points]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            cells = [(r+dr, c+dc) for dr, dc in shape]
            if all(0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w and grid[rr][cc] == 0 for rr, cc in cells):
                for rr, cc in cells:
                    out[rr][cc] = color
    return out
'''
open(os.path.join(p,'task-b78dec1e.py'),'w').write(code)
print(os.path.exists(os.path.join(p,'task-b78dec1e.py')))
